name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 7 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 47 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-10-17, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.86 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
